title: The Annunciation
description: The Angel Gabriel appears to Mary to announce that she will conceive and bear the Son of God, and Mary humbly gives her consent.

title: The Visitation
description: Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth, who is pregnant with John the Baptist, and Elizabeth recognizes Mary as the Mother of the Lord.

title: The Nativity
description: Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world, is born in poverty in a stable at Bethlehem.

title: The Presentation
description: Mary and Joseph present the infant Jesus in the Temple at Jerusalem in accordance with the Law of Moses.

title: The Finding in the Temple
description: After searching for three days, Mary and Joseph find the twelve-year-old Jesus in the Temple, discussing scripture with the teachers.

title: The Baptism in the Jordan
description: Jesus is baptized by John, the Holy Spirit descends like a dove, and the Father proclaims Him as His beloved Son.

title: The Wedding at Cana
description: At Mary's request, Jesus performs His first public miracle by changing water into wine at a wedding feast.

title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
description: Jesus preaches the Gospel, calls everyone to repentance, and forgives the sins of those who draw near to Him.

title: The Transfiguration
description: Jesus reveals His divine glory on Mount Tabor to Peter, James, and John, shining like the sun alongside Moses and Elijah.

title: The Institution of the Eucharist
description: At the Last Supper, Jesus offers His Body and Blood as bread and wine, instituting the Holy Mass and the Priesthood.

title: The Agony in the Garden
description: Jesus prays intensely in the Garden of Gethsemane on the eve of His death, sweating blood as He accepts the weight of human sin.

title: The Scourging at the Pillar
description: Jesus is bound to a stone pillar by Roman soldiers and brutally whipped, enduring physical torment for our sake.

title: The Crowning with Thorns
description: Soldiers weave a sharp crown of thorns, press it into Jesus' head, and mockingly dress Him up to ridicule His kingship.

title: The Carrying of the Cross
description: Jesus, weakened and bleeding, carries the heavy wooden cross through the streets of Jerusalem up to Mount Calvary.

title: The Crucifixion
description: Jesus is nailed to the cross and hangs in agony for three hours before dying out of total love to redeem humanity.

title: The Resurrection
description: On the third day, Jesus rises glorious from the dead, defeating sin and death forever.

title: The Ascension
description: Forty days after His Resurrection, Jesus ascends body and soul into Heaven to take His place at the right hand of the Father.

title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
description: Ten days after the Ascension, the Holy Spirit descends like tongues of fire upon Mary and the Apostles gathered in the Upper Room.

title: The Assumption of Mary
description: At the end of her earthly life, the Blessed Virgin Mary is taken body and soul into heavenly glory.

title: The Coronation of Mary
description: Mary is crowned by the Holy Trinity as Queen of Heaven and Earth, surrounded by all the saints and angels.
